description: Source code for audio transformation utilities specific to Windows platform, including media format conversion, media type creation, and audio transform setup using Media Foundation APIs.

classes.name: WinAudioFormat
classes.description: Helper class to create and manage Windows-specific audio format structures based on input stream info.

methods.name: ConvertToWin32AudioCodec
methods.description: Converts internal media audio codec enum to Windows Media Foundation GUID format.

methods.name: ConvertToWin32TransformType
methods.description: Returns the GUID for the Windows Media Foundation transform type based on the codec.

methods.name: ConvertToWin32OutputFormat
methods.description: Returns the GUID for the output format based on the codec.

methods.name: WinAudioFormat::CreateAacAudioFormat
methods.description: Creates a WAVEFORMATEX structure for AAC audio stream.

methods.name: WinAudioFormat::CreateAc3AudioFormat
methods.description: Creates a WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE structure for AC3 audio stream.

methods.name: CreateAudioTransform
methods.description: Creates and configures a media transform object for audio decoding based on stream info.
